heading: Regularizations
description: Corrections employees have asked for on their own attendance — a missed check-in, a day marked absent that wasn't. Approving one rewrites the attendance record for that day, so the corrected day is what payroll pays against.
emptyPendingDescription: Requests appear here when an employee asks for a correction to their attendance.
emptyOtherDescription: Switch the status filter to see the other requests.
reviewOnlyNote: You can review requests but not decide them — approving or rejecting needs an HR Admin role in this institute.
